programmes.d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.
In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.
A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.
Bob and Millie wake up to find they are in a strange town. Everything appears to be props - trees, animals even cars.
A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.
Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.
With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.
A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.
A man considers several possibilities when offered one wish by a genie.

At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.
An astronaut arrives back on Earth, then notices things have changed in his absence.
Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.
Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.
A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.
The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.
A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.
A man makes a deal with the devil to ensure the success of his newspaper.
Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished - even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
Jess-Belle enlists the aid of a local witch who casts a spell that makes Billy-Ben fall in love with her.
Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...
Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.
An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.
